newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Sec to support LG Semicon shrs.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Sec to support LG Semicon shrs.

text.p: Hyundai Securities will support the share price of LG Semicon Co to keep the stock from falling below its initial public offering subscription price, a statement from South Korea's Securities Exchange Commission said on Friday.

South Korean securities regulations call for underwriters of an initial public offering (IPO) to prevent the stock from falling below its subscription price for up to six months after it starts trading on the stock market.

Hyundai, along with Dongwon Securities, Dongsuh Securities and Boo Kook Securities, will place buy orders at LG Semicon's subscription price of 20,000 won if the lower end of the stock's daily trading range drops below that level, the statement said.
LG Semicon shares, which began trading for the first time on November 9, closed Friday's session at 21,500 won. Their lowest permissible price for Monday is set at 19,700 won.
The Seoul stock market will be closed on Saturday for computer systems upgrade by the Korea Stock Exchange.
